title: How Much of You Is Water, and Why It Matters
description: How much of the human body is water and what that water does, from the USGS and the NIH.
narration: How much of your body is actually water? For an adult, up to 60 percent of the body is water. Your brain and heart are about 73 percent water, and your lungs about 83 percent. Even your bones are about 31 percent water. Babies are born at about 78 percent. Every one of your cells needs water to work. Water also carries waste material out of the body. Sweating, using the bathroom and even breathing out all cost your body water, so you have to drink to replace it.
